verdict.rationale: Partitioning outputs document elements with metadata in a "contextualized JSON format", and a by-page chunking strategy implies page awareness, so some element-level provenance is suggested. Nothing in the pack shows that structured-extractor fields carry page numbers, bounding boxes, or source snippets. missing for 10: per-field provenance on schema-extracted values, explicit page-number and bounding-box coordinate metadata, source snippet/citation linkage, documentation of the metadata schema, independent or hands-on corroboration.
